blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. In this lesson, "My Computer", you learn the everyday English you need to talk to the help desk or join an online meeting.

You will learn five useful words: laptop, screen, mouse, keyboard and charger. You will also practise short, natural sentences with my and your.

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it!

items.q: Which five words does the lesson teach?
items.why: O texto diz: "laptop, screen, mouse, keyboard and charger".

items.q: When do you need this English?
options: When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
When you write a long report
items.why: "the everyday English you need to talk to the help desk or join an online meeting."

items.q: What does "one step at a time" suggest about learning here?
options: You should learn slowly and calmly
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time" pede calma, não pressa.

items.q: The sentence "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests the lesson wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase e "You can do it!" passam confiança, não medo.

items.q: Which two words will you practise in short sentences?
items.why: "short, natural sentences with my and your."

blocks.instruction: Ouça James ajudar um novo colaborador a preparar o computador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. I'm James, from IT. Let's set up your computer together. It's easy, don't worry.

First, this is your laptop. It's new, and it works well. Please put it here on your desk. Good. Now, look at your screen. Is it clear? Can you see the words? Great.

Next, your mouse. Move it a little. Does it work? Yes? Perfect. And here is your keyboard. Try to type your name, please. Very good.

One more thing. This is your charger. When your laptop is low, you plug it in here. Keep the charger in your bag when you travel.

So, your laptop, your screen, your mouse, your keyboard and your charger — everything is ready. If something looks strange, call IT. My phone is on your screen, at the top. We are a small team, but we are very fast. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is James?
items.why: "I'm James, from IT."

items.q: What does James ask you to do with the keyboard?
items.why: "Try to type your name, please."

items.q: When do you use the charger?
items.why: "When your laptop is low, you plug it in here."

items.q: James says "don't worry" and "it's easy". This suggests he wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: "It's easy, don't worry" passa calma ao novo colaborador.

items.q: "We are a small team, but we are very fast." This suggests IT will…
items.why: Inferência: "very fast" indica que respondem rápido, apesar de pequenos.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I put my laptop in my bag every night." A laptop is a…
items.why: Laptop = notebook (computador portátil).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My ___ is very clear, so I can read the text."
items.why: Screen = tela; é o que você olha para ler.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I click with my ___ to open the file."
items.why: Mouse = mouse; você clica com ele.

items.q: "I type fast on my keyboard." A keyboard is a…
items.why: Keyboard = teclado; é onde você digita.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My laptop is low. Where is my ___?"
items.why: Charger = carregador; você usa quando a bateria está baixa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando você fala com o help desk. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please turn on your laptop." To turn on means to…
items.why: Turn on = ligar.

items.q: "When it is low, plug in the charger." To plug in means to…
items.why: Plug in = plugar, conectar na tomada/energia.

items.q: "Please log in with your name." To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar (na conta, no sistema).

items.q: "If it is slow, restart your computer." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar (desligar e ligar de novo).

items.q: "Something looks strange, so I will call IT." To call IT means to…
options: ask the tech team for help
items.why: Call IT = chamar o time de tecnologia para ajudar.
